inputs.description: Really upgrade the firmware? This reboots the boxes.
Build file on the box, e.g. file:///var/nsinstall/build-14.1-51.80_nc_64.tgz (FIPS boxes only: use the FIPS image)
Which site or box (e.g. site_cle or cle_adc_01)

tasks.label: 1. Discovery tool (Windows python)
tasks.detail: Read only. Uses Windows python (python.exe) even from WSL. Asks for the nsadmin password. Not for a brand-new box.

tasks.label: 2. Precheck Cleveland one box
tasks.command: source ~/nsenv/bin/activate && ansible-playbook -i inventories/example/sites.yml mpx.yml --tags precheck --limit cle_adc_01 -e @vault.yml --ask-vault-pass
tasks.detail: Safe. Only checks the settings files. Does not touch the box (no save runs with --tags precheck).

tasks.label: 2b. Dry run Cleveland one box (--check)
tasks.command: source ~/nsenv/bin/activate && ansible-playbook -i inventories/example/sites.yml mpx.yml --check --diff --limit cle_adc_01 --skip-tags ha -e @vault.yml --ask-vault-pass
tasks.detail: Read-only dry run: logs in and reads the box, changes nothing.

tasks.label: 3. Build Cleveland one box
tasks.command: source ~/nsenv/bin/activate && ansible-playbook -i inventories/example/sites.yml mpx.yml --limit cle_adc_01 --skip-tags ha -e @vault.yml --ask-vault-pass
tasks.detail: Builds cle_adc_01 only. Skips HA. Saves config at the end.

tasks.label: 4. Build HA pair (Cleveland)
tasks.detail: Both boxes cabled and reachable. Primary = ha_primary or cle_adc_01. Licenses one box at a time (LAS reboots).

tasks.label: 5. Upgrade firmware
tasks.command: source ~/nsenv/bin/activate && ansible-playbook -i inventories/example/sites.yml upgrade.yml --limit ${input:limit} -e upgrade_confirm=${input:confirm} -e upgrade_target_version=${input:target} -e upgrade_build_url=${input:buildurl} -e @vault.yml --ask-vault-pass
tasks.detail: Reboots boxes. Saves + backs up first. Pick 'true' at the prompt or it stops.

tasks.label: 6. Edit vault (passwords)
tasks.command: source ~/nsenv/bin/activate && if [ -f vault.yml ]; then ansible-vault edit vault.yml; else ansible-vault create vault.yml; fi
tasks.detail: Holds vault_mpx_nsroot_password and vault_rpc_node_password. Never upload this file.
